# Juzly Holdings
> Dual-hub enterprise systems, business intelligence, digital marketing, corporate event architecture, and frontier expeditions.

## Summary
Juzly Holdings Pty Ltd is an operational parent firm directing institutional governance, integrated enterprise systems, high stakes stagecraft, and autonomous wilderness expeditions across international markets. Strategic advisory and executive governance are anchored in Australia, supported by specialized IT and operational delivery centers in Colombo, Sri Lanka.

## Core Capabilities
- Juzly Technologies: Full-lifecycle Odoo ERP architecture, multi-entity accounting, and supply chain automation.
- Juzly Business Intelligence: Automated cloud ETL pipelines, predictive forecasting, and executive KPI decision cockpits.
- Juzly Integrated Solutions: B2B pipeline generation, HubSpot CRM enterprise architecture, and conversion rate optimization.
- Juzly Experiences: Mainstage live governance, corporate summit production, delegate badge tech, and cross-border vendor steering.
- Juzly Holidays: Curated executive travel itineraries, corporate board retreats, and autonomous wilderness expeditions.
